English

Generated Narrative: CodeSystem KGGrcStatus

This case-sensitive code system http://smart.who.int/base/CodeSystem/KGGrcStatus defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
approved ApprovedApproved by the GRC.
not-required Not requiredGRC review was not required — a §1.9 product, or a consolidation of previously approved, unchanged recommendations.
not-reviewed Not reviewedContains recommendations and was not reviewed by the GRC — including those published before the GRC was established in 2007, which the handbook says should be updated (§12.5.2).

name: KGGrcStatus
title: Knowledge graph L1: grc status
description: Whether the Guideline Review Committee approved the publication. All WHO publications containing recommendations must be approved (handbook §1.10.1); a consolidated guideline whose recommendations were all previously approved and unchanged does not require review (§1.7.2). Absent means not recorded — not the same as not reviewed. Source: smart-kg ontology/l1/l1.json valueSets "grc-status"; WHO handbook for guideline development (2014), §1.7.2, §1.10.1.

concept.definition: GRC review was not required — a §1.9 product, or a consolidation of previously approved, unchanged recommendations.
Contains recommendations and was not reviewed by the GRC — including those published before the GRC was established in 2007, which the handbook says should be updated (§12.5.2).
